### Candidate 1: Feminist Structure Signal

* **Exact Title:** Thinking about Kitchens. Beyond Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky Conference on the occasion of the 100th Anniversary of the Frankfurt Kitchen
* **Source URL:** `https://www.e-flux.com/announcements/637326/thinking-about-kitchens-beyond-margarete-sch-tte-lihotzky/`
* **Publication Date:** November 13, 2026 (Conference dates: November 20–21, 2026)
* **Verified Facts:**
  * Organized by the University of Applied Arts Vienna (Die Angewandte) on November 20–21, 2026, marking the 100th anniversary of Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky’s 1926 Frankfurt Kitchen.
  * Re-examines the kitchen as an architectural model, a design-historical artifact, and a gendered space of domestic/reproductive labor under capitalist economies.
  * Features presentations and discussions in German and English by scholars and practitioners including Maria Shéhérazade Giudici, Ruth Hanisch, Bettina Buchendorfer, Eva Engelbert, and Ljubica Jakšić.
* **Relevance to Muki:** Directly engages with women's labor, care work, domestic architecture, and the spatial infrastructure of social reproduction.
* **Proposed Section:** Feminist Structure Signal
* **Duplication Assessment:** New signal. No overlap with recent issues.

### Candidate 2: Visual Culture Signal

* **Exact Title:** The Photography Triennial: After Dark
* **Source URL:** `https://www.mcny.org/exhibition/photography-triennial-after-dark`
* **Publication Date:** November 18, 2026 (Exhibition opens November 20, 2026)
* **Verified Facts:**
  * The Museum of the City of New York (MCNY) opens its second Photography Triennial, titled *After Dark*, co-curated by Marina Chao and Senior Curator of Prints and Photography Sean Corcoran.
  * The exhibition gathers contemporary photographs documenting NYC after sunset across all five boroughs, examining nighttime commerce, third-shift labor, nightlife, social gatherings, and urban leisure.
  * Participating photographers include Adam Pape, Anh Nguyen, Avion Pearce, D'Angelo Lovell Williams, Dina Litovsky, Elle Pérez, Lynn Saville, Tommy Kha, Ken Schles, and Kia LaBeija.
* **Relevance to Muki:** Explores nocturnal urban space, third-shift labor, photographic archives of urban life, and body/identity representation after dark.
* **Proposed Section:** Visual Culture Signal
* **Duplication Assessment:** New signal. No overlap with recent issues.

### Candidate 3: China / East Asia Signal

* **Exact Title:** 「恵比寿映像祭2027」総合テーマおよび参加アーティスト第一弾発表 / Announcement of Main Theme and First Participating Artists for Yebisu International Festival for Art & Alternative Visions 2027
* **Source URL:** `https://topmuseum.jp/contents/index-4993.html`
* **Publication Date:** November 18, 2026
* **Verified Facts:**
  * Tokyo Photographic Art Museum (TOP Museum) announced the main theme "Rules of Play" (あそびのルール) for the 17th Yebisu International Festival for Art & Alternative Visions (YEBIZO 2027, held Feb 5–21, 2027).
  * The museum revealed the first wave of participating artists, including Guerreiro do Divino Amor, Miyaow, Tomo Kihara (木原共), Akihiko Taniguchi (谷口暁彦), and Lisa Marina Komiya + Chihiro Suzuki (小宮りさ麻吏奈+鈴木千尋).
  * The festival focuses on game mechanics, media rules, and play systems in contemporary moving image art.
* **Relevance to Muki:** Covers East Asian moving image culture, media archaeology, game mechanics, and institutional technology curation in Tokyo.
* **Proposed Section:** China / East Asia Signal
* **Duplication Assessment:** New signal. Distinct from previous TOP Museum entries (such as the Kimura Ihei 50th Anniversary exhibition).

### Candidate 4: AI Research / Creative Tech Signal

* **Exact Title:** VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
* **Source URL:** `https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23950`
* **Publication Date:** November 19, 2026
* **Verified Facts:**
  * Research team (Hongji Yang, Yucheng Zhou, Jianbing Shen et al. from University of Macau, Lightspeed, CUHK, NUS) introduces VOL-Agent and Video Orchestration Language (VOL).
  * The framework decouples film structure compilation (declaring characters, props, scenes, and shot dependencies as an object graph) from execution runtime.
  * Includes static compilation/verification, dynamic runtime skill loading, self-crafting of director skills, and structural memory across multi-scene minute-scale film generation.
* **Relevance to Muki:** Replaces single-prompt AI video generation with a domain-specific programming language (DSL) workflow, providing structured control over narrative continuity and agentic film production.
* **Proposed Section:** AI Research / Creative Tech Signal
* **Duplication Assessment:** New signal. No overlap with recent issues.

### Candidate 5: Archive / Long Read / Opportunity

* **Exact Title:** Call for Applications: ZeMKI Visiting Research Fellowship 2027
* **Source URL:** `https://zemki.uni-bremen.de/en/call-for-applications-zemki-visiting-research-fellowship-2027/`
* **Publication Date:** November 16, 2026 (Application deadline: December 7, 2026)
* **Verified Facts:**
  * Centre for Media, Communication and Information Research (ZeMKI) at the University of Bremen opened applications for its 2027 Visiting Research Fellowship.
  * Supports international scholars for a 4-week research stay in Bremen focusing on media transformations, platform governance, audio-visual history, datafication, or digital media studies.
  * Provides office space, research infrastructure, and integration across ZeMKI's 11 research labs.
* **Relevance to Muki:** High-quality research opportunity directly aligned with media archaeology, platform governance, and digital archive history.
* **Proposed Section:** Archive / Long Read / Opportunity
* **Duplication Assessment:** New signal. No overlap with recent issues.
